judged_posts.what: Now and then Lumi lies in the grass with a few friends while a cloud above gathers into a heart, fish and pig, each shouted out by a friend; shown as one traced still of the heart over the treetops.

judged_posts.form: Something the visitor can now do from the browser
judged_posts.recipe: viewer-controlled pointer object that friends react to
judged_posts.title: Your moth
judged_posts.what: The visitor's browser mouse pointer becomes a moth over the island; friends chase and leap for it, sulk if it goes over the sea, and it lands on Lumi if held still.

judged_posts.form: Still or film of a failed fix or failed take
judged_posts.recipe: film of a failed take of the moth feature
judged_posts.title: Nobody cared about the moth
judged_posts.what: A film of the first failed take of the moth: friends stand still while the moth flies round their noses because their notice timer was late.

judged_posts.what: A film of Lumi and Wibbles lying in the grass while a cloud heart above comes apart and swims off as a fish; the traced film of the already-posted cloud-watching event.

judged_posts.what: A traced still looking north-east from the beach at a small copy of the island out at sea whose figures move live as the creatures do in the other game copy, with a paper boat on its way.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film: a prop or spell, a group romp, a spoken punchline

judged_posts.form: Permanent change to the island's look or places

judged_posts.what: A fenced pen holds little ones built from mixed body parts of the friends' kinds; friends visit and hug their favourite, and every few minutes the two most hugged parents produce the next generation with some mutation, shown in a film at the fence.

judged_posts.what: The whole island tilts on a point under the sea toward where the friends stand; they run to the rim at a shout, it tips and the low shore goes under, they run uphill and overshoot.

judged_posts.what: Everything the friends say pours out as sand under their feet, piling into dunes that bury the cottage over a sped-up film; high dunes slump and carry them down.

judged_posts.recipe: same sand-from-speech rule, another film take, one friend rising on shouts
judged_posts.title: Gloop says Higher!
judged_posts.what: A second take of the same sand rule: Gloop shouts and rides a rising column of poured sand above the trees, with jagged black edges at the bottom.

judged_posts.form: New world rule that makes the creatures reshape the ground, shown in a film
judged_posts.recipe: friends act out a small gag (slide down a hill) on the sand rule, filmed

judged_posts.what: Friends standing on sand dunes throw themselves down the slope on their bellies, shouting, filmed from far away.

judged_posts.form: Change to how the island is lit: a quiet still of new light
judged_posts.recipe: new evening lighting on the whole island, shown as a quiet still
judged_posts.title: Lit from below
judged_posts.what: A raster still of the game's own view of the shore at the hour when the sun has sunk below the north sea and shines up from under the water, leaving only a faint warm glow on the undersides of the tree crowns; nothing moves or happens, and the traced film failed.

judged_posts.form: New world rule acted out by the crowd, shown in a distant film
judged_posts.recipe: all friends coupled by a new physical rule, crowd drifts into a heap, filmed from far
judged_posts.title: Tied together
judged_posts.what: From high above, about ten friends are tied in a row to one red rope across the meadow. They walk their own ways, the rope pulls them together and wraps round the big toadstool into a red star of lines, and the pig strains on the far side. Nothing on the island changes besides the tangle.

judged_posts.form: Lumi-led set-piece gag film, close up, with a comic payoff

judged_posts.what: In a close path-traced film Lumi swells into a clear green jelly ball, rolls over Pinchy so the crab floats visibly inside the glass, wobbles about, then squashes and hiccups Pinchy out over the top, and Lumi and Pinchy stand apart again; nothing else on the island changes.

judged_posts.form: Physical chain-reaction contraption, camera tracking its run
judged_posts.recipe: Lumi-made domino run, physics chain reaction tracked by the camera

judged_posts.recipe: new island-wide physics rule (own gravity, orbiting debris ring), launch close up then wide shot from far

judged_posts.what: From the meadow a pumpkin, a ball and Pinchy fly up into the sky, then from far out a tilted band of hundreds of thrown-up things circles the island, dipping through the sea on one side; the island now has its own gravity and keeps whatever the day throws up in orbit.

A big patch of sand blinks on and off over the grass, and no stomp, ring or friend thrown into the air can be seen. The meant change, ground that rings like a drum when stomped, does not show.
